entities.name: Obscura
entities.description: One of the five crime families of New Capenna, a cabal of gifted wizards and mystics who rely on cunning, secrets and manipulation.

entities.name: New Capenna
entities.description: The city-plane home of the five crime families.

entities.name: Raffine
entities.description: The sphinx-demon leader of the Obscura, whose cryptic visions shape its plots.

entities.name: Kamiz
entities.description: Raffine's right hand cephalid in the Obscura.

entities.name: Navy
entities.description: An Obscura spy secretly aligned with the Adversary.

entities.name: The Adversary
entities.description: A figure with whom the spy Navy is secretly aligned.

entities.name: Oskar
entities.description: A human informant of the Obscura.

entities.name: Queza
entities.description: Kamiz's right hand cephalid in the Obscura.

entities.name: Tivit
entities.description: A Sphinx seer and fortune teller of the Obscura.

entities.name: Toluz
entities.description: A human woman and barehanded fighter of the Obscura.

entities.name: Cloud Spire
entities.description: The Obscura headquarters, a seemingly inaccessible skyscraper in Park Heights.

entities.name: Park Heights
entities.description: A district of New Capenna with rarified parlors, home to the Cloud Spire.

entities.name: Mezzio
entities.description: A district of New Capenna where the Obscura are concentrated.

entities.name: Caldaia
entities.description: A district of New Capenna with scummy sewers where Obscura are also found.

entities.name: Angels
entities.description: Rulers whom the Obscura served as mystics, wizards and advisers before the city's founding.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: An invasion during which the Obscura, Riveteers and Brokers defended New Capenna.

entities.name: Riveteers
entities.description: A crime family of New Capenna that defended it during the New Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: Brokers
entities.description: A crime family of New Capenna that defended it during the New Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: Cabaretti
entities.description: A crime family of New Capenna absent during the New Phyrexian Invasion.

events.summary: Before the city's founding, the Obscura served the Angels as mystics, wizards and advisers.
events.quote: Before the city's founding, the Obscura served as mystics, wizards, and advisers to the Angels.

events.summary: During the New Phyrexian Invasion the Obscura, Riveteers and Brokers defend New Capenna in sparse groups while the Cabaretti are absent.
